anchors.0: Absent, unusable or contradicted by evidence.
anchors.3: Competent commercial baseline but not premium.
anchors.4: Premium and coherent across all declared stresses.

eligibility.formula: binaryContractsPass && hardVetoCount===0 && craftScore>=layerThreshold && criticalDimensionsMin>=4 && resilience===1 && canonClosure===1 && evidenceFresh && codexSightedApproved
eligibility.dimensionEvidenceLaw: Every scored dimension requires one concrete observable selector, rule, behavior or sighted observation. Missing evidence scores zero until Codex review.
eligibility.resilienceCaseFloor: Declared cases must include every applicable case from stressMatrix for the family's critical dimensions; a lane may add cases but never remove the floor.

familyCompletionContract.progressUnit: A family accepted by Codex after source-bound before/after evidence; files visited, files changed, lines, comments, tests, generated output and agent reports never count as progress.
familyCompletionContract.countingLaw: No Claude status increments completed-family progress. Only Codex may turn a pending family into ACCEPTED after independent machine and sighted review.
familyCompletionContract.sourceChangeLaw: ELEVATED requires a material productive source change that closes named observable defects. Tests, docs, comments, snapshots, stories, generated CSS/dist and token declarations without a causal live consumer cannot make a family ELEVATED.
familyCompletionContract.partialLaw: A shallow or partial improvement remains ASSESSED_NOT_ELEVATED and stays in the current round. The coordinator may not move on merely because every file or family was visited.
familyCompletionContract.twoChangeLaw: One or two source changes may close a family only when they close every named deficit and the unchanged applicable dimensions are independently evidenced at 4/5 or above; otherwise the family remains ASSESSED_NOT_ELEVATED.
elevatedRequires: before defect ledger covers every applicable rubric dimension and names the dominant product defect
paired before/after evidence uses the same tree, content, viewport, container, locale, density, rhythm, state and tenant path
all applicable rubric dimensions have source-bound evidence and a before and after score
every applicable critical dimension is at least 4/5 after the change
weighted craft score clears the layer threshold after the change
zero applicable P0 or P1 product defects remain
all applicable binary contracts pass and hard veto count is zero
the applicable stressMatrix floor is exercised without lane-selected omission
tenant controls mutate the rendered family causally and restore the exact default through static and DB paths
the minimum non-color tenant-divergence axes for the family layer are observable on the same React tree
material improvement breadth is met unless every unchanged applicable dimension already proved the premium floor
all new prototype requests are adjudicated and canonClosure, resilience and pathParity equal 1
alreadyReferenceGradeRequires: no productive source edit is made merely to manufacture progress
fresh before evidence alone clears the layer threshold
every applicable critical dimension is already at least 4/5
all applicable binary contracts, stress cases and tenant-divergence axes pass
hard veto count and unresolved applicable P0/P1 defect count are zero
Codex independently confirms the sighted claim

cssOwnershipContract.roundScopeExit: Every CSS rule, custom-property writer and custom-property read changed or owned by the round is classified; zero dead, orphaned, unowned or causally disconnected CSS may be handed off as complete.
cssOwnershipContract.fullProgramExit: R5/R6 establish classification over the productive Modern corpus, not only touched files; R7 repeats the full classification after customization-depth changes.
cssOwnershipContract.familyOwnershipLaw: Visible component CSS maps to one canonical family, stable part and reachable state or recipe. Shared CSS has one named foundation/runtime owner and may not become a shadow family skin.
cssOwnershipContract.tenantAuthorityLaw: Every tenant-variable rendered decision is reachable through the one canonical static BrandTheme and DB TenantTheme chain. Direct authoring is reserved for bounded brand/Advanced values; broad behavior normally derives through capability, profile, semantic channel, group recipe/anatomy/emphasis and family-private values.
cssOwnershipContract.structuralInvariantLaw: A legitimate non-customizable structural literal is allowed only when named as a family or foundation invariant and proven not to encode tenant identity. It must not be mislabeled as customizable.
deadCssDefinition: stylesheet not imported into the productive source graph
selector that cannot match canonical anatomy or any reachable applicable state
custom-property writer with no productive reader and no declared external contract
custom-property read with no canonical emitter, typed fallback or explicit external owner
rule superseded at equal or higher cascade in every reachable state
engine or compatibility mirror with no reachable consumer
generated output whose source owner no longer emits the rule
cssOwnershipContract.retirementLaw: Delete dead CSS only with family/owner attribution, consumer census, successor where visual capacity exists and source-to-generated reconciliation. Dead census is evidence, never deletion permission by itself.

dimensions.question: Does the family have valid stable anatomy and compose lower layers without rebuilding them?
Are title, subtitle, body, label, support, code and numeric roles deliberate and resilient?
Do radius, silhouette, seams, dividers and current/selected posture form one grammar?
Do grounds, gradients, motifs, elevation and protected content zones express a coherent material model?
Do intrinsic layout, containers, density, rhythm and type scale reflow without collisions or unjustified holes?
Does the family provide an intentional simplified mobile posture and narrow-container behavior?
Are applicable states complete, meaningful and driven by semantic motion recipes?
Are all icons semantic DS icons with role, weight, size and non-color meaning?
Are names, relations, keyboard, focus, contrast, forced colors and pointer modalities correct?
Do EN, ES, AR/RTL and long content work while FR/PT key parity stays intact?
Do loading, empty, partial, error, retry, success and late-data states preserve layout and recovery?
Do governed controls cause meaningful same-tree tenant divergence and exact restore?

sightedCriteria: optical alignment between sibling regions, metric baselines and label-value tracks
overlay entry and exit preserve a perceptible spatial relationship with the anchor
secondary actions remain quiet by default and reveal through intent without becoming unreachable
